errors.name: InvalidCoreContract
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when Core is not a deployed 6529Stream Core.

errors.name: InvalidAdminContract
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the admin dependency is not a StreamAdmins contract.

errors.name: InvalidRecordFamilyRegistry
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the family classifier is not the required deployed registry.

errors.name: FunctionAdminUnauthorized
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when caller lacks global or target-scoped function authority.

errors.name: MetadataMutationPaused
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when metadata mutation pause is active.

errors.name: CollectionDoesNotExist
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the collection has not been created in Core.

errors.name: CollectionMetadataFrozen
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when render-affecting metadata is mutated after Core freeze.

errors.name: CollectionMetadataLocked
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a locked record type or snapshot is mutated.

errors.name: InvalidMetadataRecord
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a metadata record has missing identity or commitment fields.

errors.name: MetadataURITooLarge
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a metadata URI exceeds launch limits.

errors.name: MetadataRevisionMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when an optimistic revision does not match storage.

errors.name: MetadataRecordTypeLimitExceeded
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a collection would exceed the launch record-type cap.

errors.name: InvalidSnapshotId
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a snapshot identifier is empty.

errors.name: CollectionSnapshotAlreadyPublished
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a snapshot identifier already exists.

errors.name: InvalidSnapshotFamilySet
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a snapshot does not declare a strict nonempty family set.

errors.name: InvalidSnapshotRecordType
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the snapshot payload is not an admitted SNAPSHOT-family record.

events.name: CollectionMetadataAdminContractUpdated
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when the admin dependency changes.

events.name: CollectionMetadataRecordSet
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a typed collection metadata record is set.

events.name: CollectionMetadataSnapshotPublished
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a snapshot manifest record is published.

events.name: CollectionMetadataSnapshotFamilyAuthorized
events.natspec: @notice Emitted once for every exact record type covered by a snapshot.

events.name: CollectionMetadataLockedEvent
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a record type is locked against mutation.

functions.name: streamCore
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the Core contract this metadata module extends.

functions.name: adminsContract
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the active StreamAdmins dependency.

functions.name: recordFamilyRegistry
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the immutable exact record-family classifier/authority host.

functions.name: isStreamCollectionMetadata
functions.natspec: @notice Returns true for deployment validation.

functions.name: streamModuleFamily
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the module family beacon.

functions.name: streamModuleVersion
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the module version beacon.

functions.name: streamModuleSchemaHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the launch schema hash for this module.

functions.name: streamModuleSupersedes
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the immediate predecessor module, or zero for the first version.

functions.name: updateAdminContract
functions.natspec: @notice Updates the active admin contract.

functions.name: setCollectionRecord
functions.natspec:
@notice Stores the first typed collection metadata record for a record type.
 @dev Later updates must use `setCollectionRecordWithRevision`.

functions.name: setCollectionRecordWithRevision
functions.natspec: @notice Stores a typed metadata record if the expected revision matches.

functions.name: publishCollectionSnapshot
lockCollectionRecord
functions.natspec: @notice Locks a record type against mutation.

functions.name: collectionRecord
functions.natspec:
@notice Returns the latest stored record for a type.
 @dev Lock-only entries return `locked=true` and may have zero content fields.

functions.name: collectionRecordTypeCount
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the number of known record types for a collection.

functions.name: collectionRecordTypeAt
functions.natspec: @notice Returns one known record type by index.

functions.name: latestCollectionRecordHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the latest record hash for a collection/type pair.

functions.name: snapshotHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns a published snapshot hash by identifier.

functions.name: snapshotCoveredRecordTypesHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the ordered covered-record-type commitment for a snapshot.

functions.name: collectionSnapshot
functions.natspec: @notice Returns a published snapshot view by identifier.

functions.name: latestCollectionSnapshotId
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the most recently published snapshot identifier for the collection.

functions.name: latestCollectionSnapshotHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the most recently published snapshot hash for the collection.

functions.name: isLocked
functions.natspec: @notice Returns whether a record type is locked.

functions.name: deriveCollectionRecordHash
functions.natspec: @notice Computes the domain-separated record hash without writing.

definition.name: IStreamCollectionMetadata
definition.natspec: @notice Interface for outside-Core collection metadata records and snapshots.
